title: Week 2 of my adventure game set in Arabia
author: Zenpher
selftext:
I made some major improvements to terrain generation, especially focusing on the Nile but of course everything is still very rough. Also added increased rendering distance and more camera control so I can get a better look at the wider landscape.

The only thing stopping me now is I ran out of usage on pro account after a few hours 🙃

comments.author: IoncedreamedisuckmyD
comments.body: What kind of game is it?

replies.author: Zenpher
replies.body:
do you mean genre or platform?

For genre I'm still not 100% decided but I'm leaning towards a story game set in the late 600s. It's something that not too many people have explored in games.

As for platform, so far this runs inside a browser but optimization is proving to be a battle. I'll see how far I can push it.

replies.author: ElwinLewis
replies.body: There is a ceiling to the browser, at the very least hope you’re using WebGPU and not WebGL
